name: LegalZoom
subcategory: legal documents, privacy compliance and business administration
tagline: Collect business facts and fill clearly labeled draft templates for lawyer review

pricing.notes: Typical monthly Business Advisory plan; package details vary by state.

tiers.name: Business Attorney Plan, 6 months
tiers.limits: $259 prepaid every 6 months; equivalent to $43.17/month; unlimited 30-minute consultations on new matters; document review up to 10 pages/document
tiers.notes: Not available month to month, so recurring monthly field is null.

tiers.name: Business Attorney Plan, 12 months
tiers.limits: $469.08 prepaid for 12 months; unlimited 30-minute consultations on new matters; document review up to 10 pages/document; 1 annual 1-hour consultation after 6 months
tiers.notes: Annual effective price shown by LegalZoom.

pricing.hiddenCosts: Ongoing representation, court matters, documents over 10 pages, and work beyond included consultations/review are extra; participating-attorney work is discounted 25%, not included. Filing and government fees remain separate.

verdictSummary: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For LegalZoom, collect business facts and fill clearly labeled draft templates for lawyer review. The hard boundary is licensed attorneys, filings, registered agents, support, and legal responsibility, plus expert judgment, compliance, and regulated services.
coreLoopDIY: Collect business facts, fill clearly labeled draft templates, track versions and approvals, and repeatedly state that the output requires review by a qualified lawyer.
requirements: jurisdiction-specific templates supplied by the user or counsel
whatYouLose: licensed attorneys, filings, registered agents, support, and legal responsibility
moatNotes: expert judgment, compliance, and regulated services
ongoingBurden: law changes, jurisdiction, template provenance, access, signatures, filings, deadlines, evidence, retention, security, and professional liability
whyPeopleStillPay: People still pay for LegalZoom because the durable value is expert accountability and regulated execution; document generation alone cannot supply either. The recurring cost buys law changes, jurisdiction, template provenance, access, signatures, filings, deadlines, evidence, retention, security, and professional liability, not just the visible interface.

alternatives.name: Cooley GO Docs
alternatives.desc: Free guided generators for common startup formation, financing, employment, and governance documents; narrow business scope and mandatory human review included at no extra charge.

alternatives.name: Orrick Tech Studio
alternatives.desc: More than fifty free startup forms and generators from a law firm; excellent for common company paperwork, irrelevant for divorce, wills, and most consumer law.

notes: Editorial comparison targets the Business Advisory Plan plan and a internal questionnaire and template tracker DIY substitute. Recheck price before merge.
prompt:
Build a closest honest personal substitute for LegalZoom in an empty repository.
Use Next.js 15, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, and a versioned Markdown template engine; do not offer alternative stacks.
The core loop is: collect business facts, fill clearly labeled draft templates, track versions and approvals, and repeatedly state that the output requires review by a qualified lawyer.
Make the first run work locally with one documented command.
Store all user data locally by default and make export straightforward.
Put secrets in .env, ship .env.example, and never commit credentials.
Create versioned questionnaires, reusable fact fields, conditional sections, templates, and approval states.
Show the source, jurisdiction, owner, reviewed date, and expiry date for every template.
Generate DOCX and PDF drafts with prominent draft and review-required labels.
Keep an immutable audit log of answers, template version, generation time, downloads, and approvals.
Add role-based access, retention, export, encrypted backups, and a deadline calendar.
Display legal-review warnings before generation and again before any final download.
Include clear empty, loading, success, and recoverable error states.
Add input validation, safe filenames, and graceful handling of unavailable APIs.
Write focused tests for the core transformation and one end-to-end happy path.
Create a README with setup, architecture, permissions, data location, and backup steps.
Do not add accounts, billing, telemetry, analytics, or a hosted control plane.
Do not claim to reproduce proprietary data, network liquidity, regulated access, or frontier infrastructure.
Deliberately leave out legal advice or guaranteed compliance.
Deliberately leave out government filings, identity verification, and registered-agent services.
Deliberately leave out automatic consent decisions or deployment without qualified review.
Finish by running the tests and listing the exact commands used.
